message.content: LiHua expresses curiosity about how The Lord of the Rings novels tie into the TV series "The Rings of Power." They bring up this topic during a conversation with EmilyBurnett, who mentions that she has seen the movies but hasn't read the novels yet, suggesting that the rich background and lore from the books could be beneficial for understanding the TV series better. LiHua's interest in the novels indicates their eagerness to explore the expansive universe that the "The Rings of Power" series seeks to expand upon, particularly the intricate details and character backstories that are likely to be more thoroughly explored in the book series.
